meaning: Passive: be done to. Also honorific.

examples.reading: せんせいにほめられた。
examples.gloss: I was praised by the teacher.

usage: One form, three jobs. Direct passive: 先生にほめられた (I was praised). Adversity passive: 雨に降られた (I was rained on, to my annoyance). Honorific: 先生が来られる.
The doer is marked with に: 犬にかまれた.

compare.difference: For ichidan verbs the shapes are identical (食べられる). For godan verbs the potential uses the え-row instead (書ける).
The causative makes someone act. The passive describes what happens to you. They combine as 食べさせられる, 'be made to eat'.
